name: application-plan-billing-card
title: Plan & Billing Card
description: Current-plan summary card: plan name, price, an active-status badge, a usage bar with current/limit counts, the renewal date, and Manage/Upgrade actions.
useWhen: Showing a logged-in user's current subscription plan and usage on an account or billing settings page.
You want one glanceable card combining plan identity, quota consumption, and renewal timing, rather than separate widgets.
Offering both a neutral 'Manage plan' action and a promotional 'Upgrade' action side by side.
avoidWhen: You're comparing multiple plans for a purchase decision — use a Pricing table instead.
You only need a bare quota number with no plan identity or renewal context — use Usage Meter instead.
responsiveBehavior: The card is a fixed-width block that stacks its header, usage bar, and action row vertically at all widths; the two action buttons split evenly and never wrap.
accessibility: The usage bar's percentage is also stated as literal current/limit numbers in text, not conveyed by the bar's width alone.
The status badge uses both color and text ("Active") rather than color alone.
'Manage plan' and 'Upgrade' are both real, distinctly labeled buttons so their different intents (neutral vs. promotional) are clear from text, not just visual weight.

variants.title: Plan & Billing Card
variants.description: A Pro plan at $49/mo, Active badge, an 82%-filled API requests usage bar (8,200 / 10,000), a renewal date, and Manage plan / Upgrade buttons.
accessibility: Usage percentage is computed and displayed as text alongside the visual bar.

variants.title: Plan & Billing Card (Dark)
variants.description: The same plan summary card adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Status badge and usage-bar fill color remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
